RAJYA SABHA
————
List of Questions for ORAL ANSWERS
to be asked at a sitting of the Rajya Sabha to be held on
Tuesday, the December 9, 2003/Agrahayana 18, 1925 (Saka)
————
(Ministries: Civil Aviation; Finance; Petroleum and Natural Gas;
Tourism and Culture; Water Resources )
Total number of questions—20
Delhi-Patna Alliance Air flight
†*101. PROF. RAM DEO
BHANDARY: Will the Minister of CIVIL
AVIATION  be pleased to state:
(a) whether Delhi-Patna Alliance Air
flight used to operate previously in the
evening;
(b) if so, the details thereof;
(c) the reasons for discontinuing the
flight whereas Sahara Airlines operates a
Patna-bound flight at about 3 P.M.;
(d) whether Government propose to
operate flight between Delhi and Patna in
the evening; and
(e) if so, by when and if not, the reasons
therefor?
Low cost airlines in the country
*102.SHRI R.S. GAVAI: Will the
Minister of CIVIL AVIATION  be pleased
to state:
(a) whether Government propose to
promote low cost Airline Services in the
country;
(b) if so, the details thereof;
(c) if not, the reasons therefor;
(d) whether proposals for providing
point to point services by private operators
are pending with Government;
(e) if so, the details thereof; and
(f) by when decision is likely to be taken
on these proposals?
Offloading of cross-holdings by
oil PSUs
*103. SHRI N.R. DASARI:
SHRI V.V. RAGHAVAN:
 Will the Minister of PETROLEUM
AND NATURAL  GAS be pleased to
state:
(a) whether it is a fact that the Public
Sector Oil Companies have decided to
offload cross-holdings among them in the
stock market; and
(b) if so, the details thereof togetherwith
the amount estimated to be raised by each
of the PSU oil companies by such offloading
and the  purpose thereof?

Grant of additional pension
*104. SHRI ANIL SHARMA: Will the
Minister of FINANCE be pleased to state:
(a) whether Government have received
any representations/appeals from the
various Trade Unions or individuals during
the last two years for reconsideration of
granting additional pension at the rate of
one per cent per year to those Central
Government employees who have rendered
more than 33 years of service, with effect
from 1st January, 1996 as recommended
by the Fifth Pay Commission;
(b) if so, the details thereof and whether
Government propose to reconsider the
matter in keeping the recognition of the
services rendered by them; and
(c) if so, by when orders to this effect
are likely to be issued?
Research on Himalayan Glacier
Hydrology
*105. SHRI K. RAMA MOHANA
RAO: Will the Minister of WATER
RESOURCES be pleased to state:
(a) whether an International Group
consisting of Scientists from UK, Nepal and
India conducting Research on Himalayan
Glacier Hydrology has concluded that as
glacier system is melting under global
warming, water from the Himalayas will
make river Ganga monsoon fed;
(b) whether they have also held a view
that the proposed linking of rivers will not
be viable after 25 years; and
(c) if so, what is Government's reaction
in this regard?
Restoration of air services between
India and Pakistan
†*106. SHRI UDAY PRATAP SINGH:
Will the Minister of CIVIL AVIATION be
pleased to state:
(a) whether Government are considering
a proposal to resume air services between
India and Pakistan;
(b) if so, the details thereof; and
(c) what safety steps have been
considered in view of terrorists' activities?
Promotion of tourism in Jammu and
Kashmir
†*107. SHRIMATI MAYA SINGH:
Will the Minister of TOURISM AND
CULTURE be pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that Prime
Minister during his recent visit to Kashmir
announced a package to improve and
promote tourism industry in the State;
(b) if so, the details thereof;
(c) the details of the outlines of the
scheme to implement the said package; and
(d) the number of tourists visiting the
State during 2000-01, 2001-02 and 2002-
03 and whether Government holds a view
that by implementing the package, the
number of tourists is likely to go up?
Cultural centres to promote art and
culture
†*108. SHRIMATI  KUM  KUM RAI:
Will the Minister of  TOURISM AND
CULTURE  be pleased to state:
(a) whether Government propose to set
up cultural centres in order to promote Indian

Culture and Art in various parts of the
country including Bihar;
(b) if so,  the  details thereof, State-
wise, including Bihar; and
(c) if not, the reasons therefor and the
steps being taken by Government in this
regard?
Adoption of tourist sites
*109. DR. NARAYAN SINGH
MANAKLAO: Will the Minister of
TOURISM AND CULTURE  be pleased
to state:
(a) whether any proposal for the
adoption of any tourist site in Rajasthan
by Public Sector  Undertaking for
protection, conservation, development and
maintenance is under consideration;
(b) if so, the details thereof; and
(c) the existing arrangement available for
generating sustained tourist interests in the

RAJYA SABHA
————
List of Questions for WRITTEN ANSWERS
to be asked at a sitting of the Rajya Sabha to be held on
Tuesday, the December 9, 2003/Agrahayana 18, 1925 (Saka)
————
(Ministries: Civil Aviation; Finance; Petroleum and Natural Gas;
Tourism and Culture; Water Resources)
Total number of questions—153
Aviation financial package for
Rajasthan
640. MISS MABEL REBELLO: Will the
Minister of CIVIL AVIATION  be pleased
to state:
(a) what is the new aviation financial
package for Rajasthan to develop
infrastructure in the State, as announced by
Government;
(b) how far it will help to boost tourism
from abroad as  well as within the country;
and
(c) whether a similar proposal is also
under consideration for other States; if so,
the details  thereof?
Proposal from Air Asia
641. SHRI AMAR SINGH:
SHRI ABU ASIM AZMI:
Will the Minister of CIVIL AVIATION
be pleased to state:
(a) whether Government have received
any proposal from Air Asia of Malaysia
to start its operations in India;
(b) if so, the details thereof; and
(c) what action Government have taken
thereon?
Expenditure on airport security
642. SHRI NILOTPAL BASU: Will the
Minister of CIVIL AVIATION be pleased
to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that CISF has
substituted the respective State  police
forces for ensuring the security of airports
under Airports Authority of India;
(b) if so, the details thereof;
(c) whether this has led to an increase
in expenditure of Airports Authority of
India;
(d) if so, the details thereof;
(e) whether Government have taken up
the issue of this increased expenditure with
appropriate authorities because AAI is
possible not responsible for this decision;
and
(f) if so, the response thereto?
New air traffic stipulation
643. SHRI K.B. KRISHNA
MURTHY: Will the Minister of CIVIL
AVIATION  be pleased to state:
(a) whether international civil aviation
authorities are considering  lowering of air
traffic corridors from 40,000 ft to 20,000
ft and also the gap between two corridors

141
S2\WIN2\NSESSION \ 3653RS 141
from 4000 ft to 2000 ft. to allow increased
air traffic;
(b) whether the new stipulations include
enforcement of licence regulations for Air
Traffic Controllers; and
(c) whether Pakistan has already
introduced licencing system for ATCs as
an abundant safety measure and if so,
whether India is likely to follow suit?
Modernisation of airports in Southern
States
644. DR. DASARI NARAYANA RAO:
Will the Minister of CIVIL AVIATION  be
pleased to state:
(a) what are the on-going projects of
modernisation of airports in the Southern
States, State-wise and airport-wise; and
(b) what is the present status of each of
these projects?
AI's code sharing agreement with
Lufthansa
645. SHRI K. RAHMAN KHAN: Will
the Minister of CIVIL AVIATION  be
pleased to state:
(a) whether direct flights to the USA
from Bangalore, Hyderabad and Kochi have
been introduced as a  result of new code
sharing agreement between Air India and
Lufthansa; and
(b) if so, details of the flights so
introduced?
Global partnership for safe air travel
646. SHRI ABANI ROY: Will the
Minister of CIVIL AVIATION  be pleased
to state:
(a) whether Government have called for
global partnership to make air travel fully
secure;
(b) if so, the details thereof;
(c) whether a conference on Civil
Aviation Safety  and Security was held in
New Delhi recently; and
(d) if so, the details of discussions held
in the conference and the outcome thereof?
Non-functional metal detectors at
airports
647. SHRI EKANATH K. THAKUR:
Will the Minister of CIVIL AVIATION  be
pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a  fact that not a single
door-frame metal detector put up at airports
across the country is functional;
(b) whether it is also a fact that he has
uncovered a Rs. 12 crore door-frame metal
detector scam in his Ministry;
(c) if so, whether Government have made
any investigations in this matter; and
(d) the action Government propose to
take in this regard?
Food item banned by BCAS
648. SHRI EKANATH K. THAKUR:
Will the Minister of CIVIL AVIATION  be
pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that the Bureau
of Civil Aviation Security has struck off
pickles from the list of banned items in hand
baggage; and
(b) if so, the list of the items that are
banned and not banned in the new modified
list?
Airspace Management

  SHRI C. RAMACHANDRAIAH:
